description: What every window's webview may call beyond Diff Trek's own commands: every window, not just main, because each git dt launch and File > New Window opens another. App commands registered with generate_handler! are allowed without listing; core plugin commands are not, and without event listening the Settings menu item has no way to reach the dialog. The window size and scale factor turn a file dropped on the window into a point on the page, since the webviews disagree about the units they report it in. Each window titles itself after what it shows, so that the Dock's and the Window menu's lists of windows can be told apart.
